summary: The Ricky Carmichael-endorsed Championship Motocross duology that directly precedes THQ's MX trilogy.

entries.title: Championship Motocross featuring Ricky Carmichael

emulation.notes: Use DuckStation or original PlayStation hardware.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation presentation with emulator upscaling

primary.why: Championship Motocross featuring Ricky Carmichael is a PlayStation-only THQ/Funcom Dublin release. A Nintendo 64 port was planned but cancelled, so the PlayStation version is the only sourced playable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original PlayStation hardware or DuckStation.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or rerelease; Nintendo 64 port was cancelled.

emulation.notes: Use DuckStation for the PlayStation primary route; SameBoy can preserve the Game Boy Color adaptation.

primary.why: Championship Motocross 2001 released on Game Boy Color and PlayStation. The PlayStation version is the higher-fidelity full-console route, while the Game Boy Color release is a handheld adaptation with no sourced content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation version on original hardware or DuckStation; use Game Boy Color only for portable preservation.
